art_direction: 云白纸飞机 · 向风: 灰蓝底，奶白折纸飞机斜向上，深蓝折面藏着机灵眼睛。
composition_variation: A single elegantly folded paper airplane with a subtle character face on a flat desaturated blue-gray field. Paper-white large upper wing, one soft midnight-blue inner triangular fold, no extra crease lines. The aircraft points diagonally up-right with a compact beautiful angular silhouette softened just slightly at the tips. Two tiny expressive dark oval eyes sit together on the broad white side panel near the nose, facing the viewer in a three-quarter orientation. One eye can be subtly narrower for a clever hopeful expression. A small flat mouth only if it improves clarity. The silhouette is balanced, airy, about 65 percent width, fits the circle crop. No trail, clouds, text, windows, engines or realistic aircraft elements. Crisp three-color drawing, an understated imaginative little character.
style_inspiration: Continuing the established minimalist flat-color avatar collection, with newly invented everyday-object characters, restrained palette and generous negative space. Text-only generation; no source or generated image was supplied as binary model input.
